text:
alex: RFC landed for stream framing change — we now emit explicit event markers for function_call and structured outputs. Need to pick where to put the compat shim (gateway vs runtime) before we start rolling.
priya: high level: gateway shim = fast to ship, per-tenant opt-in flag. runtime shim = cleaner (single place) but touches hot path.
sam: gateway path is tempting. we can sniff header and rewrite frames on the fly. cost: extra proxy cpu and tail latency risk.
jorge: runtime shim worries me for KV-caching and batching interactions. if we inject/remove frames in runtime we may break prefix cache keys.
maria: telemetry ask: can we emit a compatibility metric per-tenant so we can measure correctness and perf delta? need tagging.
alex: Agree on metrics. proposal: opt-in header `X-RW-Compat: stream-v2` + tenant feature flag. Default remains v1 for 90 days, then opt-out deadline.
sam: Example nginx-ish sniffing approach:
```
if ($http_x_rw_compat = "stream-v2") {
  proxy_set_header X-RW-SHIM enabled;
}
```
jorge: If gateway mutates frames we must maintain byte-for-byte deterministic framing for replay/debugging. Also update trace/span tags.
priya: Rollout plan suggestion: 1) internal canary (infra team) 2) small customers + SDK partners opt-in 3) 25% traffic wave 4) fully default opt-in and start deprecation notices.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary job queued -> canary/stream-frame-shim on infra-01
maria: We should add a regression eval set (prompt/payloads that hit function-calls) before any broad rollout.
alex: Decision check: short-term -> implement gateway shim + opt-in header + telemetry. Long-term -> evaluate moving to runtime shim if we can solve cache key issues and perf regression. Anyone object?
priya: +1
sam: +1
jorge: +1 but add replay tests
maria: +1, will produce eval set
alex: OK will file follow-up RFC with rollout checklist and timelines. Thanks all :thumbsup:
